run_evaluation_scaffold: run a named evaluation by dynamically importing and executing its eval module main function
run_evaluation_with_resume: run a named evaluation with resume capability for preempted jobs using the scaffold main function
run_evaluation_with_args: run a named evaluation passing custom evaluation arguments through the scaffold main function
review_scaffold_main: review the scaffold main function that dynamically imports and dispatches evaluation modules
summarize_scaffold_main: summarize the scaffold main function that uses importlib to load and run evaluation modules
